deploybot: :rocket: Live rollout started for production environment. Tag: v4.5.0 Commit: ab12cd34initiator=christina change_window=10m mode=progressive initial_traffic=10%
christina: starting health checks, watching canary dashboards now
liam: i'll keep an eye on qps and p99s, instrumentation alerted to the new tag
rohan: reminder—legacy pin for inference runtime v3.9.1 is ready if we need a fast rollback
maya: can we confirm feature-flag states? I toggled feature-x off for the first 5%
deploybot: traffic shift update: 10% -> 25% complete, canaries healthy, avg latency +3ms, errors 0.02% :white_check_mark:
liam: seeing expected CPU bump on gpu-pool-2 but within targets
christina: good. let's hold 5m for telemetry to stabilize before next shift
sre-oncall: added an alert window for the next 10m, will page if error rate > 0.5%
rohan: if anything odd, promote fallback tag v4.4.9 with `deployctl promote --env=production --tag=v4.4.9`
deploybot: rolling to 50% now. health checks passing. logs show no new exceptions in model-server.
liam: perf regression tests passed on canary, safe to continue from my side
christina: proceeding to 75%
maya: re-enabled feature-x for 25% traffic, keeping monitoring tightened
deploybot: 75% -> 100% shift in progress

rohan: tagging the fallback path ready, standing by for manual rollback if we hit >0.5% errors
deploybot: Rollout complete — production at 100% with tag v4.5.0 commit ab12cd34. No rollbacks. Total duration ~6m. :tada:
christina: nice work everyone. adding release notes and changelog now
maya: can someone add the runtime pin note in the release notes (rohan mentioned it)
rohan: done — added `Runtime: inference v3.10, fallback v3.9.1` in the draft release notes and pushed to `release-notes/v4.5.0.md`
liam: I'll trigger the post-release perf job and validate historical baselines tonight
christina: thanks all. closing the deploy window. if anything crops up we'll open a new thread. :thumbsup:
